notes: The image is the authority: the MKR Zero is not plugged into the breadboard (despite the text); it connects to the breadboard only through the three jumper wires: red to VCC (3.3 V), black to GND, orange to D7.

DHT22/RHT03 pins VCC, SDA, NC, GND go in breadboard columns 26-29, row a (top bank). The red wire shares column 26 with VCC, the orange wire column 27 with data, the black wire column 29 with GND. Column 28 (NC) is unused.
The 100nF capacitor sits between the VCC strip (column 26) and the GND strip (column 29). The 4.7k pull-up resistor sits between the VCC strip (column 26) and the data strip (column 27).

The LiPo battery connects through its JST connector to the board's battery socket; the battery's + and - leads share the single BAT port. The microSD card sits in the board's SD slot and has no ports of its own.
Everything is powered from 3.3 V (VCC), within the DHT22's 3.3-6 V range. No LED is used, so no series resistor is needed.
